title: HushSpec Policy Signature Envelope v0.2
description: A detached Ed25519 signature over the canonical form of a resolved HushSpec policy. Stored as a .sig JSON file next to the policy. Normative prose: spec/hushspec-signing.md. The signature covers the RFC 8785 canonical serialization of this object with the `signature` member removed.

format_version.description: Envelope format version. Verifiers MUST reject any other value, reporting it as unsupported_format_version rather than malformed_envelope (spec/hushspec-signing.md section 6.2).

algorithm.description: Signature algorithm. Only ed25519 (RFC 8032, pure, no pre-hash) is defined in 0.2. Verifiers MUST reject any other value, reporting it as unsupported_algorithm rather than malformed_envelope (spec/hushspec-signing.md section 6.2).

key_id.description: sha256 of the DER-encoded SubjectPublicKeyInfo of the signing key (RFC 5280 / RFC 8410). Used to select the key from a keyring; verifiers MUST reject a key_id that is not in the keyring.

signed_at.description: When the signature was made, RFC 3339 UTC with millisecond precision and Z suffix.

expires_at.description: Optional expiry. A verifier whose current time is at or after this instant MUST treat the signature as invalid.

policy_version.description: The policy's metadata.policy_version at signing time, when present. Verifiers with a recorded last-seen version for this policy name MUST reject a lower value (rollback protection).

policy_name.description: The policy's name at signing time, when present. Together with policy_version it scopes rollback protection.

content_hash.description: Content hash of the resolved policy (spec/hushspec-canonical.md section 5). NOT a hash of the file bytes: reformatting the YAML does not invalidate the signature, changing a base policy in the extends chain does.

signer.description: Human-readable identity of the signer. Covered by the signature; informational for verifiers.

signature.description: The 64-byte Ed25519 signature, base64url encoded without padding (RFC 4648 section 5), over the canonical form of this envelope without the signature member.
